experiences.description:
Provide advisory consulting services focused on driving operational excellence and client engagement strategies within B2C and B2B environments. Partner with leadership teams to develop processes, manage key initiatives, and ensure alignment with client objectives.
● Supported client relationship strategies, enhancing communications and stakeholder engagement.
● Led and managed internal communications processes, policy development, and knowledge- sharing initiatives.
● Designed performance metrics to track progress against defined goals and improve team performance.
● Coordinated executive leadership meetings, retreats, and strategic planning sessions.
● Developed and presented status dashboards and reports to leadership teams.
● Managed corporate events, conferences, webinars, and sponsorship activities.

Oversaw daily operations/projects to include, but not limited to; technical optimization initiatives, marketing and analyst engagement projects, accounts payable, vendor management, payroll/benefits, event planning and general operations for HQ based functions. 

● Directed cross-functional projects to improve product visibility and rating with industry analysts such as Gartner and Forrester.
● Served as liaison between client UAT teams and internal technical teams, identifying and addressing gaps in requirements.
● Designed KPIs to evaluate project success; conducted triage meetings to assess testing status and manage issue resolution.
● Oversaw payroll, benefits, accounts payable, vendor relations, events, and internal operational workflows.
● Supported technical optimization initiatives and marketing programs aligned with company growth goals.

Managed all HR, operations, and corporate functions; led initiatives across media production, content management, and strategic planning.
● Directed talent acquisition, employee relations, training, compensation, and performance management.
● Built and managed annual budgets; supported strategic planning for business expansion and partnerships.
● Negotiated service and vendor contracts to improve quality and cost efficiency.
● Oversaw UAT testing of broadband product rollout across U.S. markets.
● Led research and development of a multi-language television content strategy for South Asian
markets.
● Collaborated with international partners to curate regional programming.
● Hosted a weekly TV segment focused on immigration policy and community affairs.

experiences.position: Manager Human Resources & Assistant to the CEO
experiences.description:
Provided strategic and operational support to the CEO and leadership team. Managed HR operations and coordinated cross-functional project teams.
● Managed U.S. and international recruiting, on-boarding, HR policy development, and compliance.
● Led project teams through successful delivery of initiatives on time and within budget.
● Supported finance operations, including accounts payable, receivables, and budget alignment.
